Attached is the compiled evidence packet: redwood_vm_evidence_summary.pdf (one-page executive summary + evidence index), sbom_export_20270614.csv (CycloneDX-derived CSV with checksums), pen-test-summary-2026.pdf (executive summary + current remediation table), and redwood_vm_playbook.xlsx (SLA language and operational runbook excerpts). Key highlights below: 

- SAST/DAST: We run scheduled SAST on all open-source and internal repo PRs (static results integrated into CI) and quarterly DAST against public endpoints of the hosted API. For dedicated/private customers we perform contractually scoped black-box DAST on request.
- Patch SLA: Critical security vulnerabilities — mitigation or compensating control deployed within 24 hours; confirmed patch rollout within 72 hours unless customer-specific constraints apply and are documented via a change advisory. High/important — mitigation plan within 7 business days.
- Pen-test (Feb 2026): 18 findings (2 critical, 5 high, remainder medium/low). Critical items were mitigated with compensating controls within 48 hours and code fixes rolled into 2-week sprint; all items closed as of Apr 2026. A remediation CSV is attached in the pen-test summary.
- SBOM: CSV includes component, version, license, checksum. We can provide CycloneDX or SPDX formats on request.

Attachments: redwood_vm_evidence_summary.pdf; sbom_export_20270614.csv; pen-test-summary-2026.pdf; redwood_vm_playbook.xlsx
